[p][/p][previewyoutube="LbyPZ3-poI8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Hello Contractors![/b][/p][p]We're back with another exciting update as we continue to build ContractVille in line with our roadmap. This time, we're rolling out [b]important bug fixes[/b] along with two major additions: the [b]Pool[/b] and the [b]Garage[/b]![/p][p]To celebrate this milestone, [b]ContractVille is 50% off[/b] as part of the [b]ContractVille Daily Deal[/b]!
Now's the perfect time to jump in—or to gift it to a fellow contractor.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/?snr=1_2108_9__2107"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]🎥 [b]Don’t forget to check out the video we’ve prepared for this update![/b][/p][p]We’ve put it together to give you a closer look at what’s new.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Let’s dive into the full update notes...[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Pool[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/5f75c605086452157b727324ed5b0ff7095e2642.gif"][/img][/p][h3]🏊 A Summer Touch to Your Garden[/h3][p]Bring some summer vibes to your builds![/p][p]With the new [b]Pool[/b] feature, you can now [b]add a refreshing touch[/b] to the garden of your house in ContractVille. Whether you're going for a cozy backyard or a luxurious villa, the pool is the perfect detail to complete your design.[/p][p]This new feature allows more customization for outdoor spaces and adds a seasonal, decorative element to your houses.[/p][p]These are ornamental pools, not for swimming, but perfect for elevating the atmosphere of your outdoor spaces. And that’s not all:
We’ve also added a variety of [b]decoration items[/b] specially designed for your pool areas![/p][p]From [b]life buoys[/b] and [b]sun loungers[/b] to [b]umbrellas[/b] and more, you can now fully customize the look and feel of your poolside. Whether you're going for a relaxing retreat or a vibrant summer setup, the choice is yours.[/p][p]Just like balconies and porches, [b]pools come in three sizes[/b]: [b]small[/b], [b]medium[/b], and [b]large[/b]. Pick the one that best fits your plot!
💡 [i]Tip: Don’t forget to leave space for your pool when designing your layout in the planner.[/i][/p][p]Once you've made your choice, you’ll see exactly how much space it occupies, making it easier to plan ahead.
And of course, as with all ContractVille features, the [b]Pool is fully customizable[/b]. Choose your favorite [b]pattern[/b], decide on a [b]color[/b], and build the pool that best matches your design vision.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/845f239b6a9cca9797fea387df7208ad3cdec0fd.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Garage[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/2aa6e632354a92f21fd126a4a9a9486b55e3f796.gif"][/img][/p][h3]🚗 Your Car Deserves a Home Too[/h3][p]Add a [b]Garage[/b] next to your house and give your vehicles the space they deserve![/p][p]Just like the Pool, [b]garages come in three sizes [/b]—[b]small[/b], [b]medium[/b], and [b]large[/b]— so you can pick the one that best suits your plot.
💡 [i]Make sure to plan ahead in the planner—your garage will need dedicated space next to your house.[/i][/p][p]As always, the [b]Garage is fully customizable[/b]. Choose the [b]type[/b] and [b]color[/b] that fits your build style. Whether you're going for a clean and modern look or something more rugged, it’s all up to you.[/p][p]And of course, we didn’t stop there—this update also brings a variety of [b]garage-themed decoration items[/b]!
From [b]shelves[/b], [b]ladders[/b], and [b]trash cans[/b] to [b]tires[/b], a [b]lifting jack[/b], [b]air tank[/b], [b]fuel tank[/b], and [b]stools[/b], there are plenty of ways to give your garage that authentic, lived-in feel.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/cee5276f55299065cad85ad77462225dac6f9e94.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]In addition to the [b]Pool[/b] and [b]Garage[/b] update, this patch also brings a meaningful improvement to [b]NPC Workers[/b].[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]🧱 NPC Workers Now Think Ahead[/h3][p]Your feedback matters, and this one’s for all of you who’ve asked for smoother workflows![/p][p]From now on, [b]NPC Workers no longer wait for a manual command to start the next job[/b].
Once you hire an NPC Worker and assign them to build, they’ll automatically move on to the next task without needing additional input from you.[/p][p]We’ve listened to your requests and hope this change makes your building process more seamless and enjoyable.
[b]Smarter workers, smoother builds![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]🔧 And There’s More…[/h3][p]Alongside smarter task handling, we’ve made several additional improvements to NPC Workers:[/p][list][*][p][b]Reduced NPC Worker Costs by 60%[/b]
Hiring help is now more affordable than ever—making it easier to grow your team early on.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Softlock Detection[/b]
NPCs now respond better when stuck, thanks to an updated softlock check system. [i](Includes automatic movement checks on timers for smoother recovery.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Clearer Notification Sounds[/b]
We've added more understandable and context-appropriate audio cues—like grunt sounds—to help you catch issues more intuitively.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Door and Window Assembly[/b]
Yes, they finally do it! NPC Workers can now [b]install doors and windows[/b] during construction.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]If you want to get our new game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445340/Sandwich_Simulator/"]Sandwich Simulator[/url] along with ContractVille, you can take advantage of the following package discount.
[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54263/?snr=2___"][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com//store_item_assets/steam/bundles/54263/fkvqhqj1weau1abs/76118da3b8ecbe5d47999ac6882bc630ab6cd8e5/header_ratio.jpg?t=1748297545"][/img][/url][/p][p][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54263/?snr=2___"]ContractVille X Sandwich Simulator[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]If you would like to follow our social media accounts, you can find "More Ways To Connect" section below.[/i][/p]

An issue where NPCs could unintentionally corrupt paint state (due to Save & Load or other factors) has been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wallpaper & Wallboard Coverage Issues[/b] 
Fixed multiple cases where doors and parts of certain walls were not covered properly by wallpapers or wallboards. [i](We are investigating the cause of a bug that causes interaction loss between interior doors that are placed too close to each other. This may still cause problems.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Navigation Causing FPS Drops[/b] 
Resolved a performance issue where the navigation system (particularly pathfinding) led to significant FPS drops. [i]We will continue our efforts to improve navigation.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Woodframe Placement Blockers[/b]
Fixed several edge cases where woodframes could not be placed during construction due to invisible or misaligned blockers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NPC Tutorial Reliability[/b]
The NPC tutorial system is now functioning more reliably. A bug that caused empty NPC names to appear and their animations to loop endlessly has been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interior Wall Cladding Visibility[/b]
The problem of part of the cladding not being visible when cladding interior walls has been solved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sliding Door & Archway Mission Compatibility[/b]
The compatibility of sliding doors and archways with mission needs has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Old Interior Walls Reappearing After Replanning[/b]

notes.title: ContractVille Full Release Now Available
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=VMT1QKgHDao;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Hello dear contractors![/b]

We have now reached the end of our early access period, which began on May 31, 2024. 
First and foremost, we would like to thank all our players who have supported us from the very beginning and helped us develop ContractVille.
With the Full Release, we would like to inform you that we have renewed the ContractVille brand and our store page and game cover have been renewed. With that, we invite you to watch our [url=https://youtu.be/VMT1QKgHDao]Full Release Trailer[/url].

With the release of ContractVille 1.0, we are starting a new beginning. The end of this early access period marks the beginning of a new era. We will continue to improve ContractVille and try to fulfill your wishes.

With version 1.0, we are introducing NPC Workers. We will continue to improve this update throughout 2025.

[i]ContractVille completes Full Release with the release discount.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/?snr=1_2108_9__2107

We would like to share with you our Road Map for the remainder of 2025. With your feedback, we’ll keep shaping the future of ContractVille throughout 2025 and beyond.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/2083cd699cf724f5da7077a6dd7295bbe4ab095d.png[/img]

We hear your requests and criticisms. We will continue to work hard to bring ContractVille to its full potential. 

[i]In version 1.0, many bugs were fixed. We have completed the NPC Workers update and will continue to improve it. [/i]

[h2]NPC Workers[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/272ae37790b90d154efc72d42ac9bfaf1c672573.gif[/img]

In November 2024 we did a Player's Choice Survey and the most requested update out of the 10 options was NPC Workers. 
We delivered on our promise and NPC Workers is now available in version 1.0!

Get Workers Cabin upgrades from the control panel in your office, then hire workers. Send them to your missions in active missions and lands and let them help you by giving them commands.

We read in the comments of previous announcements that you want workers to bring goods from the warehouse, but as we mentioned there, we think this would disrupt the flow and organization of the game.
We will fulfill this request with the Cargo From Storage update that we mentioned in our roadmap.

[i]If you want to learn more about the NPC Workers update that came with version 1.0, you can read the DevLogs we prepared for them.[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

We’ve been hard at work fixing a number of inconsistencies, visual glitches, and multiplayer synchronization issues to enhance your experience. Below is a summary of the most significant changes included in this update:

[h3]🏠 Building & Mission Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where placeholder houses would revert to default window and door colors instead of preserving player-installed choices after mission completion.
[*] Fixed a bug causing the “General Progress” bar to incorrectly display 25,500/100 at the start of the Build phase instead of 0/100.
[*] Exterior Cladding can no longer be installed before reaching the Exterior Work phase, and cladding installed prematurely can now be removed with the Demolish Tool.
[*] Adjusted Build Mission logic to properly complete the “Clad Exterior Walls” objective when the required amount is exceeded.
[*] Improved tile placement logic to prevent new tiles from being placed directly over existing tiles, avoiding visual glitches and z-fighting.
[*] Rug tiling behavior adjusted to prevent rugs from being trapped underneath new tiles during renovation missions.
[*] Corrected an issue where mission planning and requirement checks continued to use the metric system even when imperial was selected.
[/list]

[h3]🧰 Tools & Animation Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved texture resolution on newly added “Go Green” tool skins across all tools, particularly for the trashbag, window cleaner, paint roller, plasterer, and screwdriver.
[*] Fixed an issue where the painting animation would loop indefinitely when attempting to paint with an empty roller (0% paint).
[*] Snap Mode no longer auto-enables when placing windows while it is disabled.
[/list]

[h3]📦 Trash Compactor Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated in-game prompts for the Trash Compactor to more accurately reference “non-recycled boxes” instead of “trash.”
[*] The warning text now reads “You need two non-recycled boxes to compact!” and “Non-recycled box types need to be same!” for improved clarity and consistency.
[/list]

[h3]✉️ Mail & Contract Missions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in Mail Mission ID 19 where the progress incorrectly remained at 76% despite only a few tasks remaining. Progress now correctly reflects actual task completion.
[*] Resolved a missing rug issue in the same mission that prevented full task completion.
[*] Corrected collision and placement issues causing accessories like toilet paper in ID19 to spawn inside walls, preventing interaction.
[*] Fixed an issue in ID33 Lin Decorate Contract where guest room tiles and rugs could not be interacted with.
[*] Adjusted Clean Water Campaign logic to allow retrieval of boxes even if the ghost overlaps during the wooden plank phase.
[*] Fixed an issue where Whoopie Cushions (formerly Fart Bombs) would become invisible or irretrievable when placed behind specific vehicles.
[/list]

[h3]🏭 Factory & Item Behavior[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved interaction logic for the Advanced Factory panels to prevent repeated activation after the progress bar passes 80%.
[*] Corrected the visual and logic behavior of coupon payments even when panel progress appears stuck.
[*] Fixed a bug where aborted Build Missions could still allow digging during the planning phase.
[*] Trash Compactor logic now accurately reflects the required material types and avoids misidentifying materials.
[/list]

[h3]🎨 Visual & Save/Load Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ceiling paint now correctly saves and loads across sessions, preventing ceilings from reverting to white.
[*] Low-resolution thumbnails in the Hardware Store have been addressed for various items including roof tiles, gables, chimneys, and roof windows.
[*] Resolved visual glitch allowing mission house furniture to be pushed inside exterior walls, causing progress blockers.
[/list]

[h3]🚚 Vehicle & Physics Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where placing Non-Recycled Boxes on top of tires in a vehicle trunk caused vehicles to float upon entering the driver seat.
[*] Corrected issue with the trolley becoming immovable when overloaded with mission items and used near stairs.
[*] Prevented player vehicles from spawning in the air due to save/load conflicts with NPC vehicle spawn points.
[/list]

[h3]📦 Store & Multiplayer Consistency[/h3]
[list]
[*] The “Return All” function now works correctly for clients in multiplayer sessions.
[*] Store sales are now synchronized between server and client, including sale prices, in-store displays, and promotional emails.
[*] Resolved crash issue when combining a \$5 item with max-stock decoration items in the cart during a sale, preventing a stack overflow error.
[*] Online Store thumbnails for Contract Build Missions now correctly show the mission-specific image instead of the default Cargo Point thumbnail.
[*] Improved item need tracking in the Mission Needs tab, ensuring accessory types are accurately counted regardless of variation.
[/list]

[h3]🪟 Windows & Cladding[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect screw placements on windows near staircases, ensuring screws appear on the correct (interior) side.
[*] Resolved an issue where old windows would remain on the parcel even after demolition and repurchase of the same lot.
[/list]

[h3]🔊 Sound & Effects[/h3]
[list]
[*] Aborting Logistics or Mail Missions no longer triggers the “Mission Complete” SFX or “Vehicle Not Found” warnings.
[*] Resolved an SFX bug where the sound of filling a generator persisted even after the generator was moved away from the fuel source.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Many minor bug fixes were implemented.
[*] Many minor visual bugs have been fixed.
[*] We continue to fix and work on Crash bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.9 - Openable Curtains
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Contractors![/h3]

As we approach ContractVille version 1.0, we continue to focus on bugs.

[*] [b]Interaction Bug Fixed:[/b] Openable windows are no longer interactable after house sale or mission completion.

[*] [b]Broken/Damaged Furniture Visibility Restored:[/b] Packed damaged furniture in Decorate missions no longer becomes invisible after saving/loading.

[h3]🚗 Vehicles & UI Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fuel Value Exploit Fixed:[/b] Saving while inside a car no longer restores fuel to above half on load.

[*] [b]Taxi Pickup Bug Resolved:[/b] A passenger near the Airport area can now be picked up as expected.
[*] [b]Multiplayer Max Player Selector Fixed:[/b] Decreasing player count from 4 no longer incorrectly jumps to 2 instead of 3.

notes.title: Update 0.8 - Balcony, NPC Cars, Bug Fixes & GeForce Now, Price Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/e0694553cd59f1521669d2d34ef08763b21b17dd.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello contractors!
In this big update we bring you the new balcony and the renewed NPC cars. With this update, we are one step closer to the full release.
Before we move on to the patch notes with bug fixes, I would like to share some news with you.[/b]

[h2]GeForce Now[/h2]
As we announced last week, ContractVille will now be available on GeForce Now. We share the joy of the players who have been waiting for this. If you want to play ContractVille anytime, anywhere, without the need for a good system, you can find our game on GeForce Now.
[i]ContractVille will be available on GeForce Now on April 17 at 10am PDT.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/6e5179631ca1cf5f19ec27fd779386e5d84943d2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Discount![/h2]
With this discount, we're celebrating the balcony update and going live on GeForce Now.
It's a great time to buy ContractVille or gift it to a friend if you already own it! We recommend you not to miss this sale.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/?snr=1_2108_9__2107
[i]Start Apr 17 @ 10:00 (Pacific Time)[/i]

[h3]Price Update[/h3]
As stated in the Early Access section of our store page: [i]“ContractVille will be cheaper during Early Access. We’ll raise the price as we move towards full launch.”[/i]
With that in mind, we believe now is the right time to implement this planned adjustment, as the game has grown significantly in content and quality since its release.

We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who joined us early and helped shape the game. Your support has been invaluable throughout this journey.
[i]If you’ve been thinking about picking up ContractVille, now is the perfect time![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/d1920304ef8f67d4caa7dbfb71acb36f6a99c7e4.png[/img]
Having given you this important news...
I would now like to move on to what's new and what the update includes.
After the major updates such as Garden, Roof & Porch and Roofless Porch, we think that the balcony is a great complement to the look of a house. With this balcony update, one more thing has been added and now the houses you build look even better! 
If you're curious about what's ahead for ContractVille, you can check the "What's New?, In Development, Planned" section from the main menu.

[h2]Balcony[/h2]
You can now add balconies to your houses — a feature that expands your creative options and brings a more complete architectural look.
Balconies are a key addition for giving your buildings a natural and finished appearance, especially when combined with roof and porch elements.

[i]French Balcony[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/980293e77f9c9677951ea2e43f82df82ed015d0f.jpg[/img]

[i]Small Balcony[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/98a116d8c7d5d80dc31524c82d81ab3df72f5a8b.jpg[/img]

[i]Medium Balcony[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/254e8cf895b6e0358cc335877cc1e353735a3d39.jpg[/img]

[i]View of a house with a balcony with roof and porch[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/0a750f775c6d7a52bee59760c46ee57c4a79eb20.jpg[/img]



[h3]Plenty of Alternatives for Balcony![/h3]
Balconies are now available in four different sizes [b]— small, medium, large, and extra-large —[/b] so you can choose the one that best fits the scale of your house and lot. Whether you're building on a compact plot or a spacious estate, there’s a balcony size that matches your layout.
In addition, balconies come in three distinct styles:
[list]
[*] French-style (flush with the wall)
[*] Roofed (covered top for extra structure and visual depth)
[*] Open/roofless (for a lighter, more minimal look)
[/list]
These variations allow you to further customize your building’s exterior appearance, offering more flexibility when designing facades and upper floors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/41e502de852d15460c5c5eead54ce3b05f6ac57e.jpg[/img]

Just like the roof and the porch, you can customize every detail of your balcony! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/9de970811d374ca7c506e490d8511731212457a7.gif[/img]

[h2]Renewal of NPC Cars[/h2]
NPC vehicles have received a complete visual overhaul.
Instead of dark-windowed, opaque cars, you’ll now see vehicles with visible drivers and passengers moving through the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/225d2a5d7ec111b5b740bbeeb51eb48e0735ad37.jpg[/img]

We believe this change adds another meaningful layer to the atmosphere of Creek Harbour, helping it feel more alive and dynamic as a living city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/fa305da78b4779f05fbf6386756c0699056af9a4.gif[/img]

Let’s now move on to the bug fixes and improvements included in this update.

 [h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h2]

[b]Trolley Spawn Position Fixed[/b]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where taking control of the trolley caused it to appear to the right side of the character instead of in front. The trolley now spawns in the correct position when picked up.
[/list]
[b]Scott Mail Bathroom Tiling Overspill[/b]
[list][*] Fixed a tiling issue in the Scott Mail mission where tiles could be placed slightly beyond the bathroom door frame, preventing placement in adjacent rooms.
[/list]
[b]Resolution Lock in Borderless Fullscreen[/b]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where Borderless Fullscreen mode would incorrectly detect resolution from GPU scaling options like DSR or FSR.
The game now correctly uses your desktop's native resolution when Borderless Fullscreen is selected.
[/list]
[b]Achievement Text Clarification[/b]
[list][*] Updated the description of the "Logistics Baron" achievement to remove misleading language about "cargo," and capitalized mission names for clarity.
[/list]
[b]Excessive Tiling Requirement in Ivan Mission[/b]
[list][*] Adjusted the "Tile the Floor" objective in the Ivan Build mission. It now reflects the correct required area, even in rooms without separating interior walls.
[/list]
[b]Missing Text for Amid[/b]
[list][*] Fixed a missing text issue for Amid, where the comment was replaced by a <Missing String Table> placeholder.
[/list]
[b]Hallway Task Progress Blocked[/b]
[list][*] Resolved an issue where hallway progress would not update correctly. Tasks like painting or plastering now reflect properly and allow stage progression.
[/list]
[b]Player Marker Color Not Updating[/b]
[list][*] Fixed an inconsistency where changing the player marker color wouldn’t update the in-game head marker until reentering a vehicle or rejoining the session.
[/list]
[b]Server Crash on Eating Buff End[/b]
[list][*] Fixed a server crash that occurred when the eating buff ended after a client-side food interaction glitch.
[/list]
[b]Stuck Cargo Points in Go Green Missions[/b]
[list][*] Addressed an issue where cargo points from completed “Go Green” missions (Green City Initiative & Clean Water Campaign) remained in the game world. These are now removed correctly upon mission completion.
[/list]
[b]Imperial Speed Display Mismatch[/b]
[list][*] Corrected a display bug where the vehicle speed in imperial units appeared inconsistent with the actual numerical value.
[/list]
[b]Refund Price Bug with Sweet Talk Skill[/b]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where returning discounted items while the “Sweet Talk” skill was active refunded the full original price instead of the actual purchase price.
[/list]
[b]Recycle Trolley Query Display Bug[/b]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where recycle boxes taken by trolley caused the visible query number of paper and metal trash to display as 0.
[/list]
[b]Stacking Recycled Boxes Resets Queue[/b]
[list][*] Addressed a bug where repeatedly throwing recycled boxes on top of others in front of the bin caused the queue count to reset to 0.
[/list]

notes.notes:

With this update we are adding to the Roof & Porch update and continuing bug fixes. Over the past 1 week, we've seen that you've really liked this update and we're happy about that. We've been reading your suggestions and we've got a few improvements for you to enjoy.
Before we talk about those, I'd like to announce that we'll be holding a giveaway in honor of our Discord server reaching 10k members. 
[h3]Discord 10.000 Member Celebration[/h3]
Our community continues to grow by the day and we would like to thank everyone who is a part of it! Our Discord server has reached 10k members. 
In honor of this milestone, we will be hosting a giveaway on our Discord server. To participate in this giveaway, all you need to do is join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Contractville]Discord[/url] server and visit the #events channel.

[i]Let's get started...[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/?snr=1_2108_9__2107

[h2]Roofless Porch[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/8075d85c6a05f384000f63db4a7595468ee76586.png[/img]

We thought that porches don't always need a roof and that beautiful designs can be created with just the base, and we present the roofless porch to you with this update. We hope you like it as a novelty to beautify your garden.

[h2]Replacing Roof Tiles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/eef11bc2a72ae9142ae0f0aff1f46bf67984d9a7.png[/img]

Don't like the color of your roof? Tear it down and re... No. Now you can change it with just one click! You can change your roof with just a different Roof Tile box. This also allows you to make different designs. 

[h2]Distant City Details[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/656f20c6827f4b8743baf897ffb4ffb6df8cc175.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/76dbef0185d23fe7803642e5f0c2a96c44241cbf.png[/img]

When you look away from Creek Harbour, you can now see other cities. When it gets dark, you can see the lights of distant cities. These details are designed to make the world of ContractVille more realistic.

[h2]Some Furniture Revised[/h2]

We changed the materials of some of the furniture and added more details, so you can customize the colors of the body and details as you wish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/9c48d3e311a9e35b93cceaee3703ba7a7e88f68a.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Roof Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Snap-able Roofs:[/b] Gable Roofs can now be snapable. This feature, which was available on HIP Roofs, is now also available for Gable Roofs. In this way, it is possible to make more different designs.
[*] [b]Multi-Story Roof Placement Fix:[/b] Roofs can now only be placed on the topmost floor of multi-story buildings.
[*] [b]Roof Build Mission Completion Fix:[/b] Roof Windows and Chimneys no longer disappear when accepting the same Build Mission again.
[*] [b]Gable Roof Beam Collision Fix:[/b] The edge beams of Gable Roofs now have accurate collision and visual alignment.
[*] [b]Roof Builder (GABLE) Length Adjustment Fix:[/b] On GABLE type roofs the length of the sides can now be adjusted by the player.
[*] [b]Roof Chimney Sound Effects Added:[/b] Installation and demolition of Roof Chimneys now include proper sound effects.
[*] [b]Roof Snapping Alignment Fix:[/b] Roofs now correctly snap to adjacent roofs during Placement Mode when properly aligned.
[*] [b]Floating Roof Placement Fix:[/b] Roofs can no longer be placed in the air when the Roof Builder is activated outside the Roof Area.
[*] [b]Roof Dimension Limitations Implemented:[/b] Roof height adjustments are now restricted within reasonable limits, while length remains bound to the building plan.
[*] [b]Roof Consumable Usage Synchronization:[/b] When a roof-related consumable item is used, the server now correctly updates the item’s remaining amount.
[*] [b]Roof Height Modification Restriction After Snap:[/b] Once a Roof is snapped into place, its height and length can no longer be adjusted beyond the dimensions of the connected Roof.
[*] [b]Gable Roof Area Extension Fix:[/b] The Gable Roof can no longer be extended excessively beyond the designated Roof Area. Additionally, Roof Ends now align correctly without unintended angling issues.
[*] [b]Roof Builder Snap Dimension Alignment Fix:[/b] Roofs now retain consistent height and length when snapped together, preventing mismatches and ensuring a visually and structurally uniform appearance.
[*] [b]Fixing the Appearance of HIP Roofs:[/b] Fixed a bug with HIP roofs where the tiles on each side did not look the same.
[/list]
[h3]General Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Polish Language Update:[/b] We have made many fixes in Polish and we would like to thank our dear players who helped us with this on our Discord server and Gluciorek who single-handedly made hundreds of fixes. We also had a lot of Polish players willing to help and we thank them all for their offers. [i]Dziękuję![/i]
[*] [b]Classport Nimo Fuel Cap Fix:[/b] The problem with not being able to interact with the refueling point when interacting with the pump or gas canister to refuel the vehicle has been resolved.
[*] [b]City Furniture Store Lampshade Thumbnail Fix:[/b] Low-resolution lampshade thumbnails have been updated to match their in-game quality.
[*] [b]Box Placement Restrictions Updated:[/b] Players will no longer be able to place boxes on the heads of other players and stationary NPCs in the world.
[*] [b]Parcel Sign Interaction Fix:[/b] Parcel signs now correctly display only the intended parcel information, preventing unintended interactions with newly listed parcels.
[*] [b]General improvements:[/b] Many improvements have been made in terms of optimization and visuals and SFX.
[*] [b]Minor bug fixes have been implemented.[/b]
[/list]

At this point, I would like to remind you how important reviews are for us. Don't forget to leave your comments about our game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/]our store page[/url]! Your suggestions and warnings are very valuable to us.

Now I invite you to watch our trailer video and read our update notes to take a closer look at our 0.3 Update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/16c1ea3e31bf4c8c7077af54328f0afb05c61a74.jpg[/img]

[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/2da891b366d022acb29534d618f3b0ec211f7025.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/5dc6e76f5aaaf8e788f8e7411aceca18e47bf6d3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Efficient Deliveries, Electrified: E-Car-Go, Built for the Fast Lane of Logistics![/h3]
E-Car-Go, which we brought specially for the Cargo update, is very functional for your cargo missions. This vehicle has a load capacity of 48 and is charged electrically. It has 3 tiers with 8 separate shelves and allows you to sort and organize your cargo boxes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/a8ea641e4ca9df4d1dac9a4b4cf2892462ddc352.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/5a5479b5fb18de4369ad4710d873d5ee478dfe6f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Cargo App[/h2]
[h3]Expand Your Delivery Empire![/h3]
Using the Cargo App, you can access cargo missions. You can start 4 cargo missions at the same time. This way you can work together with your friends.
For the Cargo update, we added 2 different areas to the game where you can pick up special cargoes: the airport and the port. You can see new warehouses in these areas.
Pick up the cargo and take it to the delivery points you can see on the map, according to the addresses and numbers indicated on the boxes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/62f105fe2f27db0b4c3d4a3c0cb22dc6ee37f943.jpg[/img]

Some boxes are fragile in cargo missions. These boxes will be damaged if you crash or if you throw them out of your hand and they fall to the ground. Fragile boxes earn more money than normal boxes. Each box has a Delivery Quality and your earnings will increase or decrease accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/615e11093916687277ad0eb78f90a5af6b0436ab.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/214042fba072c29c173433fc2c999bfaeb098c1e.gif[/img]

[h2]New Achievements![/h2]
[i]New goals for Taxi and Cargo await you![/i]
We've added a series of achievements to Steam so you can show off and show off your mastery of taxi and cargo missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/18671ce9d2e1beab44673e05004702f6b14357cb.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Clothes[/h2]
[i]Refresh your look![/i]
With this update, we've added new clothes to the game. I'd like to announce that there will be more clothes-related content coming soon!
[i]You can see a few of these outfits below. I encourage you to visit the clothing store as soon as possible![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/27da745a97a91253a28a7e4594bfc2c55b413281.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/07477d58ceb9ca9622a0d48e782fade1818d51ef.jpg[/img]

We realized that there was a need for an improvement in the Mission Needs tab and made it easier to use. We provided the ability to select and view the object that needs a mission.
Now when you click on the button in the Mission Needs tab, the items you need will be listed in front of you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/e2db5420816d3bfd82b460887d4d56bb996cd1ee.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/7a731719d818bf4dd77a3f77c36118c95b7ad855.gif[/img]

[h2]Ceiling Painting Feature[/h2]
[i]Colorful ceilings![/i]
It is now possible to paint ceilings. Expand your design by painting your ceilings in different colors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/f1f4401b67b4868367072ee7f049c4b105d722c8.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/6a66ffa52ff91594a587e9eb7394fee1d184d08f.gif[/img]

[h2]Trolley Improvements[/h2]
[i]We're always here to hear from our players and gather your thoughts! We understand that using the trolley has been a bit tricky.[/i]
[list]
[*] The trolley capacity has been increased from 3 to 6!
[*] With the trolley in your hand, just use the left mouse button to pick up boxes and the right mouse button to drop them.

[*] Fixed many visual bugs.
[*] Fixed a bug where “Rescuing” the Trailer would teleport the player to the garage instead of the Trailer.
[*] Car suspensions have been revised.

notes.title: Big Update: Go Green (ContractVille 0.2 Release)
notes.notes:

[i]With this major update, we are presenting the Go Green App to you. 6 New mission types and their rewards; such as tool skins, gemstones, trophies, and cabinets where you can display them. Sculptures, Go Green t-shirt, the trailer and trolley you really wanted, and much more!
Additionally, this update includes 3 new mail missions, 9 new contract missions, over 250 new furniture items, foods and beverages, [u]optimization improvements[/u], and environmental arrangements.
[b]Don't forget to follow our game on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698780/ContractVille/]Steam Store Page[/url] to stay updated on future updates.[/b][/i]

[h1]Welcome to the Go Green![/h1]
[i]ContractVille's Go Green update brings you 6 different mission types to save the environment. [/i]

[h3]Go Green App[/h3]

You will be able to take all missions through the Go Green App on your tablet. You will earn XP from each mission and with the XP you earn, you will complete the Go Green Progress and reach the rewards. 
[i]Remember that you can do Go Green missions as many times as you want![/i]

[h3][i]Achivements![/i][/h3]
[i]We've added new achievements exclusive to Go Green, which you can view in the “Achievements” section on Steam and in your in-game profile, which you can access from your tablet.[/i]

[olist]

[*] [h2]Public Awareness Campaign[/h2]
[h3]Get the city ready for a green revolution! Put up posters, talk to NPCs, and spread your message everywhere. Raise environmental awareness and become the city's hero![/h3]
[i]There will be NPCs waiting for you in various areas of the city. Inform them about environmental pollution. For example did you know that a single plastic bottle can take up to 450 years to decompose?
Some of them may snub you and not want to talk to you. But remember, even if one person changes, the world changes.
To reach more people, you will be able to put up posters in certain areas of the city and advertise on certain vehicles in the city![/i]

[u][b][h3]Talk To People[/h3][/b][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/93245aa45bbca6470fa728b9e7b47acbf022b48a.jpg[/img]

With your shovel in hand and a little elbow grease, you’ll transform the urban landscape into a thriving green space. Every tree you plant and nurture is a step toward a greener, healthier city. [i]To succeed in this mission, your goal is to rescue animals from the filth choking their natural habitat. These poor creatures may be trapped in piles of garbage, struggling to survive. [h3][i]New Feature![/i][/h3]
[h3]Building Plans with the New System[/h3]
With the new system, you can now easily save and load building plans.
[list]
[*] Automatically saves every 5 minutes in the background. It also autosaves when you complete the planning. The number of [u]autosaves is limited to 5[/u]. Apart from this, manual save feature has been added. The number of [u]manual saves is unlimited[/u]. 
[*] Your saves in Planner are not specific to your world. When you join another world, you can use your previously saved plans.
[*] Plans will be parcel size specific. (For example, if it is a small plot plan, you can only see your save when planning on small plots).
[*] If you plan a 5-story house and want to use your saved plan while working on a 3-story house, it will load the first 3 floors of the 5 floors on your plan.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796113/6a1dfc8eb78974b186bdac6d60053629fb8c633a.png[/img]
[u]You can also share this file with your friends.[/u]
[i]To find your save files, you can copy this: %UserProfile%\AppData\Local\ContractVille\Saved\SaveGames 
Then paste it in the file explorer.

notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes: Version 0.0.8[/h2]

Greetings, Contractors! Version 0.0.8 is live!

We've been hard at work addressing several bugs and improving gameplay based on your feedback. Here’s what’s been fixed in this update:

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

1. [b]Motion Sickness Wall Painting:[/b] Resolved an issue where wall paintings were not being counted in single-player mode. Additionally, the grid appearing when loading a saved game has been fixed.
2. [b]Base Management Customizations:[/b] Fixed an issue where customizations needed to be purchased twice for the UI to update correctly. Now, one purchase will properly reflect in the UI.
3. [b]Window Cleaning Issue:[/b] Resolved a bug where holding the mouse button and switching between dirty windows caused the windows not to be cleaned by either the server or the client.
4. [b]Ottoman (Bedroom Seat) Placement:[/b] Corrected the inconsistency in placing the ottoman in the bedroom, ensuring proper placement every time.
5. [b]Exterior Cladding Collision:[/b] Addressed the inconsistent collision issues with exterior cladding, making placements more reliable.
6. [b]Stair Placement Issue:[/b] Fixed the bug where the stair ghost would disappear and prevent players from placing stairs after saving the game.
7. [b]Joshua Decorate Mission:[/b] Fixed an issue where the extract objective was not being counted when the furniture was packaged during Joshua's decorate mission.
8. [b]Notebook Placement:[/b] Fixed inconsistencies with notebook placement, ensuring it works as intended.
9. [b]Light Switch Connection Mode:[/b] Addressed an issue where interactions were disabled when in light-light switch connection mode.
10. [b]Bathroom Cabinets:[/b] Bathroom cabinets are now properly recognized for design points, ensuring they contribute to your overall design score.
11. [b]Generator and Vehicle Bug:[/b] Resolved an issue where carrying a generator and walking into a T5 or other vehicles could cause them to bug out and either fly across the map or get stuck under the map.
12. [b]Door Reversal on Save:[/b] Fixed a bug where saving or autosaving the game would cause the door of a room to be replaced with its reverse version. The door will now remain in its correct orientation after saving.

We appreciate your continued support and feedback. Please keep sharing your thoughts with us, and enjoy the improvements!
